svg.title: Checkpoints from a steered run of a language model agent become building blocks for the next run. They bend its distribution toward a new goal, which the agent reaches in three leaps
svg.desc: Two panels linked by a dashed arrow. At each step of a language model agent, a jagged ball, pale at its center with its mass out along its spikes, shows the distribution of next steps that the language model and its harness induce, and each leap is one draw from it. Left ('first run: steered through the harness'): a six-leap run through the harness corridor is faded to 58 percent opacity except for its three full-opacity red checkpoint squares at steps 2, 4, and 6. Right ('next run: with new building blocks'): those three checkpoints sit linked inside an unshaded 'building blocks' box at the lower left. Starting from its corner toward a new goal ring and runs lobe in the upper center, the building blocks bend the distribution toward the new goal. Five of the six spikes cluster within 45 degrees of the goal while the ball keeps its full ragged core, and the agent reaches the goal in three leaps and three red human balls.
svg.text: first run: steered through the harness
next run: with new building blocks
